senses.sense_definition: A damaging or false statement intended to harm someone's reputation.

examples.text: The politician refused to respond to the malicious <w>aspersions</w> cast by his opponent during the debate.
She felt deeply hurt when her colleague began to cast <w>aspersions</w> on her professional integrity.

senses.sense_definition: The act of sprinkling, particularly with holy water.

examples.text: The priest performed the <w>aspersion</w> of the congregation with holy water during the solemn ceremony.
Ancient rituals often involved the <w>aspersion</w> of sacred objects to purify them before the festival.

traits.comment: This sense is rarely used in modern English outside of specific religious or literary contexts.
